Prior to and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Bulq family]] of [[Weequay/Legends|Weequays]] maintained an '''estate''' on the Weequay [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Ruul (moon)|Ruul]]. During the Clone Wars, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]&ndash;turned&ndash;[[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]] hosted a [[Mission to Ruul (Clone Wars)|meeting]] at the estate in an attempt to kill [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and further an ongoing [[Jedi Schism]].
